purpose: Visual concepts only; example levels and XP
prompts: Create a polished full-screen 16:9 German game UI mockup for the mining roguelite Tiefenhall. The attached image is the APPROVED progression timeline design and must be faithfully retained as the main visual component: hand-painted dark walnut wood panel, ornate riveted antique brass frame, cream serif typography, warm golden horizontal milestone rail, small gold Powerup point medallions, large deep navy/turquoise exotic blueprint cards, iron ladder/lava lantern/pickhammer illustrations. Compact Level badge DIRECTLY CONNECTED to a slim XP bar at top left (no gap, no percentage text); Fortschritt heading at upper right. This is a full contextual screenshot, not a sprite sheet or several panels of variants. No developer annotations, no explanatory paragraphs or tooltips. Only concise German labels and functional controls. Refined hierarchy, comfortable spacing, all text readable. Background is a dim atmospheric underground crystal cave with still lake and warm lantern accents, subdued behind the foreground UI. Preserve the approved timeline geometry as much as possible and use matching dark wood/brass buttons. CONTEXT 1: Progression screen opened from the MAIN MENU, calm browsing state. Gold filled rail must STOP at current Level12 diamond, future rail dark metal. Small gold point medallion and short label "3 Punkte" adjacent to Upgrades indicate unspent points. Bottom-left a smaller button "Zurück". Do not show a second full upgrade page, keep main view focused on the timeline. No results or XP earned messages. Show entire panel without crop, cave visible around the edges.
